meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，当你想发短信、打电话或收验证码时，Claude 会用已装好的 `dial` 电话工具帮你操作。它自带一个可用号码，无需你配置；动手前会先查看命令说明再执行。
howto.when: 当你说到电话、短信、验证码等词，或让我发短信、打电话、等验证码，或想了解 Dial 能做什么时触发；会话中第一次使用 dial 前也会加载。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打 AI 语音电话，问她今天过得怎么样
say.note: Claude 会拨打这个号码，AI 接管对话。

say.text: 等发到本号码的短信验证码，然后告诉我
say.note: Claude 会等待入站短信并读出验证码。

howto.what_en: When you ask to send a text, place a call, or receive a code, Claude uses the pre-installed `dial` tool. A phone number is already set up, so no configuration is needed; Claude checks the tool's help before acting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phone, SMS, or verification-code words, ask to send a text, make a call, or wait for a code, or want to see what Dial can do. Also loads before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.note: Claude sends the SMS via dial.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 with AI and ask how her day is going
say_en.note: Claude places an AI voice call.

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS code to this number and tell me
say_en.note: Claude waits for the inbound SMS and reads the code.
